sources.caption:
🌿 ADIL | The Chosen One 2
The Study of Prophetic Characteristics & Manners

How can the character of Rasulullah ﷺ continue to guide the way we live, care and interact with others today?

In The Chosen One 2, we continue our journey of knowing Rasulullah ﷺ through the beautiful values he embodied — generosity, endurance, bravery and humility.

Discover also how the Prophet ﷺ taught us to uphold human dignity, live peacefully with others, care for our environment, and show tenderness, love and respect towards women, children and the elderly.

More than learning about his life, let us learn to bring his character into ours. 🤍

📚 10-hour ADIL module
📲 Register now: l.ead.me/ADILMDM2026
